result.brief: 提出高频引导的个体一致图像到视频生成框架，通过频率感知身份编码与身份 token 注入提升野生动物细粒度一致性，并构建 WildlifeVid 数据集。
result.reason: Proposes frequency-aware identity encoding and identity tokens injected into I2V cross-attention, a representation contribution for controllable image-to-video generation with a new wildlife video dataset.
